basis_kind_measurement.verdict: The 2026-09-03 hard fail is teriyaki-sauce at Walmart, whose "15 fl oz" size AGREES with the row declared unit floz, so its divisor is exact. It is one of exactly 2 crown findings today whose kind agrees with the engine divisor (the other, pickles at Sam Club, was already allowlisted 2026-08-08 for the same underlying reason without the mechanism being named). Swapping the reference to the declared unit takes the gate from hard=1 to hard=11 on day one, so it must ship as a reported and adjudicated batch, never as a same-day reference swap.
